FAQ

Cleaning questions, answered

Still not sure what you need? We'll help you pick.

Call now587-777-1408

What cleaning services does YYC Cloud9 Cleaning offer?

House cleaning, move-in/move-out cleaning, office, restaurant and commercial cleaning, seasonal cleaning, Airbnb and short-term rental cleaning, renovation and construction cleaning, carpet and upholstery cleaning, and The Home Reset, our most comprehensive top-to-bottom home restoration.

Do you provide house cleaning in Calgary?

Yes. We offer routine maintenance cleans and deep refreshes for homes and condos across Calgary, Okotoks, Airdrie, and Chestermere, personalized with your preferred cleaning products. House cleaning starts at $40/hour.

Do you provide commercial and office cleaning?

Yes. We clean offices, clinics, restaurants, and commercial spaces, including regular maintenance and high-touch surface sanitization. Custom scheduling and insured staff are standard, and commercial work is quoted per space.

Do you offer move-in and move-out cleaning?

Yes. Move-in/move-out cleans include detailed surface and appliance cleaning, wall washing, baseboard care, and inside-cupboard detailing, so you can head into inspections and handovers with confidence. From $45/hour.

Do you clean Airbnb and short-term rentals?

Yes. We provide turnkey cleaning and staging for Airbnb and short-term rentals, with thorough sanitization, linen laundering, guest-ready detailing, and quick turnarounds between bookings. From $40/hour.

Do you provide carpet and upholstery cleaning?

Yes. Carpet cleaning is $60 per room (extra if heavily soiled), and upholstery cleaning for sofas, chairs, and other upholstered furniture starts at $50. Both can be booked online.

Do you offer deep cleaning?

Yes. Choose a deep refresh, a seasonal clean that targets built-up grime and hard-to-reach areas, or The Home Reset for spaces that need more than a clean.

How do I request a quote?

Tap Get a Free Quote, call us at 587-777-1408, or email yyccloud9cleaning@gmail.com. Tell us what you need cleaned and we'll help you find the right service.

Can I book my cleaning online?

Yes. Use Book Online to choose your service and schedule your cleaning.
